notes.title: Sequel is coming next Friday, April 26!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/361790/Winged_Sakura_Mindys_Arc_2/

We're proud to officially announce Winged Sakura: Mindy's Arc 2! 

We've read through all the feedbacks you've all provided through Steam Review and our email and did the best we can on the sequel. We hope you try out the sequel and for your continued support.

All owners of Winged Sakura: Mindy's Arc will obtain an exclusive Power during the 2nd Arc of the game.

A Power is a equippable item that provides a unique passive ability.

For anyone who wishes to preview what the Power does, see the spoiler below.

[spoiler]
How to unlock: Complete Cindy's Side Story. Cindy's Side story can be initiated during Arc 2 at North Menopa. (Requires Time Travel)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7123003/d58c56938ceef6f7bdc3576b6e42330f9a8f8f9b.png[/img]

Shadow: +25% Chance to Evade an Attack, Attack Cooldown is decreased by 25%, and Lifespan will not decay.

Rage: Damage Immunity, +300% Attack, Attack Cooldown is decreased to 0.1s, and 100% Crit. The unit's HP will be decreased to 0 after Rage ends.[/spoiler]

We look forward to see what you think about our latest game. For more information, please click on Winged Sakura: Mindy's Arc 2's Steam Store page above or check out our website below.

Website: http://wingedsakura.com/mindysarc2/
WSMA2 Community Hub: https://steamcommunity.com/app/361790

notes.title: Winged Sakura: Endless Dream Loyalty Rewards
notes.notes:
We're releasing a new game on Steam this Friday! We've worked on this Project since Dec 2014. A new game means a new loyalty reward for our players!

Check out the game below!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/339250/Winged_Sakura_Endless_Dream/

All Winged Sakura: Mindy's Arc owners will get Cecilia as a Sakura in Winged Sakura: Endless Dream (WSED.) In WSED, you can select up to 30 (+2) Sakuras and they each have unique powers that can change the way you play the game.

 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7123003/1cccba5140791d05a4fb2c5b9cc594e145eb96cb.png[/img]

Cecilia changes your Element to Poison, boosts your Attack value by 2, and decrease certain in-game events by 1 turn (random events that makes enemy stronger, etc., but reward you after the event ends).

In addition, when activating Burst (class' unique skill), it will trigger an additional effect. On the .gif below, you can see Mindy activating the Archer's unique skill, instantly dealing 8 damage to all enemies.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7123003/4c8794ee6d834f8e4887912c47ccf0cbe33da88e.gif[/img]

Thank you for your continued support and please do check our new game out!

notes.title: Mindy and Minzy - Special Bonus to All Owners of WSMA
notes.notes:
Interested in seeing more Mindy and Minzy!? We have a new unannounced game: 'Winged Sakura: Demon Civil War,' estimated to be released on Steam on Thursday, December 8th, 2016. The official store page is not up yet, but we do have a screenshot to share with you guys!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7123003/3fc443d47f3dcfadf3b772cff5491e9546eb1a32.jpg[/img]
[url=http://wingedsakura.com/images/wsgp4/wsgp4_ss_01.png] For 1920x1080 view [/url]

It's a turn-based RPG! If you own Winged Sakura: Mindy's Arc on Steam, Mindy and Minzy will visit you in Winged Sakura: Demon Civil War with their new illustrated sprite from our large project and give you a little sneak peak on what our large project is about. They will also join your party and become playable characters.

We plan to offer something special in each of our new released games as loyalty offer, such as playable characters, fun items, or bonus events/quests, so there's always a benefit of owning all our games!

Thank you all for your support and we hope to have your continued support. More information about Winged Sakura: Demon Civil War will be revealed at a later date.

Have a great day!

notes.title: 2/26/2015 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Store[/h1]
- Price of Ores decreased by 40%
- Price of Enchant Stones decreased by 40%
- Price of Sakura Flowers decreased by 50%
- Price of Crafting Recipes greatly decreased

[h1]Additional Gameplay Options[/h1]
Before starting a level, there are now two checkboxes for two additional gameplay options. Please note these options reset after restarting the game.

- A checkbox to disable S-Pause to allow players to challenge themselves in Easy, Normal, or Hard mode to never ever pause the game
- A checkbox to reduce enemy movement speed by 25% for players who have a difficult time keeping up with the game

Combining both options will now allow players to play a simpler version of "Insane Mode".

Please note that the new options will only work after the Prologue and does not work on bosses or Survival Mode.

[h1]Slow[/h1]
- Mystic Squirrels can no longer immobilize a lane. Slow is now capped at 80%

[h1]End-game Bug fix[/h1]
WARNING - SPOILER FOR ANYONE WHO HAS NOT BEATEN THE GAME!
[spoiler]- Fixed a bug where Grim Reaper can kill Cecilia while she's in her "flying' state using his Scythe's Reaper attack. Grim Reaper will now automatically target a new enemy if she's "flying".	
[/spoiler]

notes.title: 1/6/2015 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Magicat[/h1]
- Improved Magicat's AI
-- Leapie is now Magicat's lowest target priority. If other enemy Spirits are within range, Magicat will now automatically target them instead.
-- Magicat will now do 0 damage to Leapie
--- Leapie can still get healed from Magicat's lightning if Magicat target's an enemy Spirit that is close to Leapie.
- The new Magicat AI can be disabled by turning "Friendly Magicat" off via in-game options. By default, it is automatically turned on.

Please note that the new Magicat AI is automatically disabled for the changing target tutorial.

[h1]Store[/h1]
- Crafting recipe's price decreased from 1/2 of original item's price to 1/10 of original item's price
- Item sell values increased from 35% to 50%
- Bag's price decreased by 65%

[h1]Other[/h1]
- Fixed multiple typos

notes.title: Steam Demo & 11/14/2014 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]DEMO[/h1]
Beside the "Add to Cart" there's a "Download Demo" button. Got friends that wanted to try the game on Steam? Now they can!

[h1]GALLERY[/h1]
A player recommended the Gallery feature to re-view CGs and we thought it was a good idea, so we quickly implemented this feature. The "Gallery" button is only visible to those who has beaten the game on the main menu. It's a quick implementation, but it'll definitely satisfy those who has beaten the game and wanted to see all the CGs without having to repeat the story.

[h1]ACHIEVEMENT FIXES[/h1]
- Fixed Enchanting Pro. It will now proc the Steam Achievement after enchanting an SSS item to +10 or above
- Fixed Mindy's Savior. It will now proc the Steam Achievement after obtaining 31 achievements.
-- If you have 31 achievements before the patch, load the game, go to your profile, and click on the "Achievement" tab to proc Mindy's Savior

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
- Fixed second boss's jumping and attack glitch where he could get stuck and not move
- Fixed a equipping tutorial crash
-- Occurs when player swaps out a character during the Equipping Spirit tutorial instead of equipping Leapie on an empty slot
- Plus many minor fixes

notes.title: 11/11/2014 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]NUMBER OF ITEM BLOSSOM REWARDS[/h1]
- Easy
-- from 1 (+1) to 3 (+1)
- Normal
-- from 2 (+2) to  4 (+1)
- Hard
-- from 3 (+2) to 5 (+1)

[h1]ITEMS[/h1]
- Sell value of Coin, Red Coin, and Gold Coin has been slightly increased

With the data we collected, we realized the number of item blossoms for Easy and Normal mode needed an increase. This should now make the game [b]more entertaining, more addicting, and more rewarding.[/b]

Hopefully this also encourages players who plays on Easy or Normal mode to eventually adapt to a higher difficulty level.

[h1]HIGHLIGHTING OVER REWARDS(?)[/h1]
- Added [  ] and [ * ] for Data Fragments
-- [  ] = not found
-- [ * ] = found

That's all for the important changes.

notes.title: 11/9/2014 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]SKILLS UI[/h1]
- Added the following text to help users remember that they can assign and remove skill points
-- "LClick = Assign Skill"
-- "RClick = Remove Skill"
- Replaced the "H" button with "E" button, short for "Equip".
- Fixed skill tutorial bug that occurs when user obtains 3 skill points before skill tutorial

[h1]EQUIPPING SKILL UI[/h1]
- "Assign Skills" is now reworded to "Drag to Equip Skills"

[h1]SPIRITS UI[/h1]
- Replaced the "H" button with "E" button, short for "Equip".

[h1]EQUIPPING SPIRITS UI[/h1]
- "Assign Spirits" is now reworded to "Drag to Equip Spirits"

[h1]UPGRADE UI[/h1]
- Fixed enchanting tutorial bug
-- It will now offer a free enchanting upgrade to any items you wish to upgrade as long as it's at +0. If the item has already been enchanted, the tutorial will end

[h1]AUTO SAVE[/h1]
- The game will now only auto save after you complete a level.
- Fixed a game breaking bug where you can break the chain of story events by loading an auto save file

[h1]STORY DIALOGUES[/h1]
- Fixed multiple typos

[h1]ITEMS[/h1]
- Nerfed Green Crossbow's attack from 17/17 to 4/4. 
-- 17/17 was a mistake and extremely OP

Plus many mini fixes that contains spoilers

notes.title: Soundtrack and Quick Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Here's a quick update:

- Fix a bug that occurs when user repeats level 1 and triggers level 2 story dialogue
- Fix a bug that occurs when user equips green bow before enchanting tutorial
- Fix typo "Cherry Blossom Pedals" to "Cherry Blossom Petals"
- Fix Winged Sakura: Mindy's Arc - Soundtrack. Now works with Steam Music Player

For those who supported us by buying our OST:

Due to our mistake, all OST owners will need to update an additional 200MB. We're sorry for the poor delivery of our soundtracks. We didn't realize our tracks were missing metadata and an album art. Our OST has now been fixed and is now compatible with Steam Music Player. I hope you'll forgive us! Sorry!

Thank you for supporting us and I hope everyone is enjoying the game!
